profile.summary: The Ujimaa Foundation is an Oakland-based nonprofit that runs after-school programs for youth at schools, often as the lead agency for a school's program. Activities include academic support, science and technology, martial arts and sports, performing arts, and gardening.

review.notes: Ujimaa Foundation (Oakland, EIN 27-0549307, 501(c)(3)) is confirmed by ProPublica, and its own site lists the Carl B. Munck Elementary after-school program named in the OUSD contract titles; phone, generic admin email, and the neutral summary are supported by the contact and programs pages. Several OUSD titles under this vendor number name Higher Ground Neighborhood Development Corporation, a separate entity not covered by this profile, so the vendor record may conflate two organizations.
